newsitem.title: UK: SOCCER-DALGLISH BECOMES A SUPER SCOUT.
newsitem.headline: SOCCER-DALGLISH BECOMES A SUPER SCOUT.

text.p: Former Liverpool and Blackburn manager Kenny Dalglish is to become a super scout for Scottish champions Glasgow Rangers.

Dalglish, who led Blackburn to the English premier league title in 1995, was named on Monday as new business development manager for Rangers' chairman David Murray's company Carnegie Sports International.
One of his duties will be to help recruit players for Rangers manager Walter Smith.

Dalglish, who left Liverpool unexpectedly after a successful six-year spell as manager, was elevated to director of football at Blackburn after their championship winning season. He quit that role in August.
